purpose: Proposed NutriGO training taxonomy; these are target labels, not labels supported by the baseline public model.
annotation_guidance: Use ingredient labels for visible ingredient instances, not inferred hidden ingredients.
Use a separate dish label for the whole meal image.
Record raw or cooked state separately when it can be reliably observed.
Do not label an item when annotators cannot distinguish it confidently.
Keep test images separate by capture session or source to reduce leakage.
